groups.name: Qilin

groups.name: Climax
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site (Ransomware.live: “ClimaxInc”); posts name plus a sector line only. Feeds merged.

groups.name: Dark Project
groups.profile: Leak site posting boilerplate “fell victim to a cyberattack” notices with volume claims.

groups.name: SilentRansomGroup
groups.profile: SilentRansomGroup (aka Luna Moth / Chatty Spider, ex-Conti team): data extortion without encryption, known for callback-phishing and helpdesk vishing against US law firms. RansomLook tracks its site as “leakeddata”.

groups.name: Anubis
groups.profile: RaaS active since December 2024 with an optional destructive “wipe mode”; heavy healthcare focus.

groups.name: BrainCipher
groups.profile: Active since July 2024; uses a leaked LockBit Black builder (Windows and Linux).

groups.name: Interlock
groups.profile: Ransomware group since September 2024; double extortion against healthcare, education and government in North America and Europe.

groups.name: MedusaLocker
groups.profile: Long-running RaaS (since 2019) relying on exposed RDP and phishing; its site mixes auto-generated “emails extracted” stubs, like today’s, with real dumps.

groups.name: PixelLeaks
groups.profile: Posts descriptive, often unnamed targets with publication deadlines and itemised record lists. Today a Nablus (Palestine) engineering firm.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023 (CISA advisory AA23-319A); publishes large file inventories, as with today’s 322 GB engineering dump.

groups.name: SilentVault
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site using masked names plus revenue/headcount and proof deadlines. Six masked teasers excluded today; one named UK food maker.
